entry.sql: SELECT e.base_part_number,e.supply_voltage_v,e.supply_current,e.phase_count,e.motor_power_w,s.service,s.torque_nm,s.torque_in_lb,s.duty_s4_percent,s.cycles_per_hour,s.starts_per_hour FROM series76.entries e JOIN series76.catalog_state c ON c.active_import_id=e.import_id JOIN series76.service_specs s ON s.entry_id=e.id WHERE e.base_part_number='761A00-11300000/A' ORDER BY s.service

na.sql: SELECT e.base_part_number,e.data_status,e.motor_power_w,e.field_status->>'motor_power_w' AS power_status FROM series76.entries e JOIN series76.catalog_state c ON c.active_import_id=e.import_id WHERE e.data_status='source_NA' ORDER BY e.base_part_number LIMIT 1

evidence.sql: SELECT e.base_part_number,t.source_page,t.source_table,e.source_row,sc.field,sc.status,sc.unit,sc.evidence FROM series76.entries e JOIN series76.catalog_state c ON c.active_import_id=e.import_id JOIN series76.source_tables t ON t.id=e.table_id JOIN series76.source_cells sc ON sc.entry_id=e.id WHERE e.base_part_number='761A00-11300000/A' AND sc.field='motor_power_w'

glossary.sql: SELECT term_key,label,definition,page FROM series76.context_terms WHERE term_key='fla' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

rows.label: Full Load Current (FLA)
rows.definition: The electric current (in Amps) drawn by the motor under its maximum rated load.

message.sql: SELECT role,content,tool_calls->0->>'name' AS tool,tool_calls->0->'parameters'->'part_numbers' AS part_numbers,tool_calls->0->'validation' AS validation,tool_calls->0->>'renderer' AS renderer FROM series76.messages WHERE role='assistant' AND tool_calls->0->>'name'='get_actuator' AND tool_calls->0->'parameters'->'part_numbers'='["761A00-11300000/A"]'::jsonb AND content LIKE '761A00-11300000/A%' ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1

rows.content:
761A00-11300000/A — weatherproof, 110 V AC 1-phase
  • On/Off torque: 700 in-lb / 80 Nm

fk.sql: SELECT conrelid::regclass::text AS child,confrelid::regclass::text AS parent,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype='f' AND connamespace='series76'::regnamespace ORDER BY 1,2,3
